name: Amplifier Browser Bridge
description: Lets an Amplifier (or any MCP-speaking) agent observe and drive this browser from another device over the user's own tailnet. Desktop build: requests the debugger permission for opt-in, per-tab CDP escalation (trusted input, hidden-tab capture) -- see docs/designs/browser-bridge.md §7. chrome.debugger is genuinely absent on Edge Android; use manifest.android.json there instead, which omits this permission.
